messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: gpu-pool-eu-west-1 queue latency > 95th pct for 10m. Error spike: OOM and job timeouts. Auto-scaler reporting failed launches (quota errors).

sara (oncall): acked. I'm on it, starting triage. Anyone see customer-facing 5xxs?

michael (infra): seeing elevated enqueue times and some failed allocation calls to cloud provider: 
```
APIError: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED: Insufficient vCPU quota in eu-west-1
```
Looks like quota is blocking autoscale.

jordan (sre): copying logs to #eng-sre channel. For quick mitigation we can: 1) fail traffic to fallback model variants (cpu-backed small model), 2) manual spin of reserved nodes in another region and route requests, 3) throttle non-critical background jobs. Which do you want first?

sara (oncall): prioritize 1 + 3. Start fallback routing now to reduce customer impact. Michael please start a cross-region spin as fallback if quota quick-fix doesn't land.

michael (infra): starting manual instance group creation in us-west-2 (spare capacity there). Running command: 
```
gcloud compute instance-groups managed create redwood-eu-fallback --size=4 --zone=us-west2-a
```
ETA ~8-12m for nodes to join.

caroline (pm): observing customer telemetry — 12 customers had elevated latency (5-20% degraded tail latency), 3 customers saw 502s on batch endpoints. No broad data loss. Updating CSMs.

sara (oncall): toggled fallback route for write-heavy customers: `route: fallback-small-model` -> `true`. Early checks show queue latencies dropping ~40%. :white_check_mark:

jordan (sre): also throttled kicker jobs (async evals) by flipping `job.priority: low` to `suppress=true`.

michael (infra): manual nodes are up in us-west-2, BGP/peering ok. Starting traffic cutover for non-sensitive customers.

ops-bot: Deploy bot: manual-deploy to us-west-2 started by michael at 2061004900.

sara (oncall): handoff: I need to escalate to day oncall at 09:00 UTC, will create bridge for postmortem prep.

caroline (pm): please capture customer impact details in the post-incident doc. I can coordinate postmortem and CSM notes.

jordan (sre): quick root cause hypothesis: autoscaler failed due to insufficient cloud quotas in eu-west-1 combined with an unexpected surge from internal eval traffic. We need a concrete repro of quota rejection path.

michael (infra): action item list (initial):
- Create Jira INFRA-4592: Increase regional vCPU buffer and automate quota requests (owner: michael, due: 2026-03-22)
- Create Jira SRE-3781: Autoscaler healthcheck + fallback circuit breaker (owner: jordan, due: 2026-03-19)
- Create Jira RUN-1120: Runbook update: manual cross-region failover steps & runbook checklist (owner: sara, due: 2026-03-18)

sara (oncall): I'll open the postmortem thread. Meeting scheduled: 2026-03-17 15:00 UTC (30m) — include infra, sre, pm, devex.

caroline (pm): add customer comms slot after postmortem. I want a one-paragraph summary and list of mitigations.

jordan (sre): immediate technical follow-ups I'm assigning to self: add explicit autoscaler retry logging and capture the full allocation payloads. Also create a canary that simulates quota exhaustion weekly.

michael (infra): temporary mitigations to keep in place until infra changes: maintain 10% spare capacity in us-west-2 and leave fallback routing enabled for low-priority customers.

sara (oncall): status update for oncall bridge notes: mitigation successful, latency back to normal for high-priority customers. Remaining: finalize postmortem, implement infra buffer, update autoscaler.

ops-bot: Reminder set by sara: postmortem-dry-run at 2026-03-17T14:30Z.

caroline (pm): assign owners in Jira once tickets exist; I'll track customer comms and approve draft.

jordan (sre): sample autoscaler config tweak we discussed: 
```
autoscaler:
  scale_up_threshold: 0.7
  max_launch_retries: 5
  quota_failback: true  # route to fallback model on repeated quota failures
```
We'll PR this to eng-config and add tests.

michael (infra): note: we need better alerting on quota margin. Current alert is at 95% vCPU usage — change to a predictive alert when projected usage hits 85% in 15m window.

sara (oncall): final immediate TODOs before handoff:
- [x] fallback routing enabled for low-priority
- [x] manual nodes spun in us-west-2
- [x] queued thrashers throttled
- [ ] open Jira tickets (michael)
- [ ] postmortem doc draft (sara + caroline)

caroline (pm): thanks everyone. We'll aim for no customer downtime windows and keep customers notified. :thumbsup:

sara (oncall): handing off to day oncall @owen for follow-ups. Owen — please own the bridge and make sure tickets get created.

owen (day-oncall): acked, joining bridge and will own ticket creation.

incident-bot: incident status: mitigated. Declaring incident state: MONITORING.

sara (oncall): postmortem next steps: add timeline, impact table (customers hit, request counts), root cause analysis, action items with owners and due dates. I'll pin the draft in this thread.

jordan (sre): I'll take lead on verifying autoscaler fixes in staging and schedule a canary run.

michael (infra): will start INFRA-4592 ticket and propose K8s quota automation.

caroline (pm): closing notes: Good quick mitigation and handoff. Need to reduce blast radius of internal eval traffic and make fallback behavior automatic.

sara (oncall): closing the incident thread — monitoring for 24h. Please update your Jira tickets and link back to this thread. :white_check_mark:
